Chapter 36 Zhou Ziheng offline (page 1)
Zhou Ziheng was offline (Zhou Ziheng was offline (page 22)) Especially the elders who were forced to do the battle before, their eyes wandered back and forth on Qin Zhengyi. Some people wanted to question, but they remembered Qin Zhengyi before Yi said he wanted to leave the clan, but he didn't dare to ask. He was afraid that if he asked, he would be crushed to pieces by them. Fan Muhe saw what they meant. She was a demon, and her perception of human emotions was better than normal. The monk is much more perceptive. She looked directly at those people, "What? You want to drive me out? I am here to be a guest. Even if you want to kill me, I am afraid that I will not take action if you all do it together!" What an arrogant thing to say! With a shocked look on his face, he knew that the demon cultivator was here. It was over! Even the Supreme Patriarch had colluded with the demon cultivator, so what else could he say? Qin Zhengyi could not be bothered to explain that nothing was as important as his own ascension. He had been cultivating spiritual plants for Lingzhi for thousands of years. No shame! "Let's go." Fan Muhe gave Mu Yu a look, and Mu Yu stepped forward and crushed Zhou Ziheng into powder, but he hid the soul without leaving a trace and gave it to the little princess to torture himself. Angry. Zhou Ziheng didn't react until he died, and he just went offline. "I asked you to bring Master Xingshu with you!" "Oh!" Mu Yunuo Nao disappeared in an instant and followed him with a pale face. Like a ghost, she is not only sad that her father is dead, but she is more afraid that the demon cultivator will turn around immediately and crush her into powder. She still wants to live, she is still young, she can't die yet, and she doesn't want to die. Zhou Xintian hid directly behind his younger brother Zhou Ziheng. When Fan Muhe was about to kill Zhou Xintian and Zhao Kang, a giant sword fell from the sky and intercepted Fan Muhe's killing move. Two Mahayana-level sword cultivators showed up. "Are the bold demon cultivators going to start a war with my righteous monks?" Zhao Kang felt the aura of death, and he didn't expect that he was saved. He crawled behind the sword cultivators. "It seems that the beast tide has subsided. It seems that we are late." Another sword cultivator blocked the hot-tempered junior brother behind him and changed the subject. He knew how to beat around the bush. He was afraid of starting a war with the demon cultivator. Although their fellow apprentices could hold down the demon cultivator, they were still one step above their combined level. There were so many righteous cultivators here who were from the Lingzhi Sect, so they would inflict one thousand losses on themselves and eight hundred on the enemy. When they heard from the head of the Lingzhi Sect, they came to help exterminate the beast tide, but they didn't expect to see such a show. When they saw that the beast tide had subsided, they planned to go back and not participate in other people's housework. However, one of their own was in trouble, so they had to show up. "Do you from the Sword Sect have to save those two people?" Qin Zhengyi asked, looking at the people from the Sword Sect, as long as they dare to say yes, they will not take the old man from the Sword Sect with them in the future!
